turns.q: What's the return policy if it turns out not to be right for me?
turns.replyTail:
If the subscription is not right for you, you may cancel anytime through your account. Marley Spoon is flexible, with no commitment: you can skip weeks, pause, or cancel.

Log in and open “Account.”
Select “Manage subscription,” then “Cancel your account.”
Follow the prompts and confirm with “Cancel account” and “Proceed.”

You’ll see confirmation and receive an email. If the next order’s cutoff has passed, cancellation will not stop that delivery.

n Support · AI

For delivery details, go to Delivery details > Delivery day & time. The courier’s tracking link also shows an estimated delivery time, which may update during the day. To track your shipment, open Current Orders and select Track Delivery.
